caption: The drawing is rendered in black and white and depicts a section of a building's exterior wall with a decorative metal railing in the foreground. The railing runs horizontally across the lower part of the composition, featuring a series of vertical bars and circular motifs integrated into a geometric pattern, with lines that show varying density to create texture. Behind the railing, there is a partial view of a doorway or open window, with a shadowed interior space visible. The doorway has a rectangular frame and is partially recessed into the wall, and a portion of what appears to be a curtain or vertical panel can be seen inside the opening. To the left of the doorway, the wall surface shows a small area of damage or peeling, revealing a slightly darker patch. The top section of the drawing captures a horizontal line that may indicate the edge of the roof or ceiling. The shading and crosshatching create a sense of depth, with the darker interior contrasting against the lighter exterior wall. There are no additional objects or figures in the drawing.
title: Wrought Iron Balcony Rail
